production.note: US model years 2015-2023. Start: The Christian Science Monitor (Viknesh Vijayenthiran, 13 Aug 2014) on 'the all-new 2015 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat'. Dodge's 2016, 2019 and 2023 specification sheets list the SRT Hellcat (dodge-charger-specs-2016, dodge-charger-specs-2019, dodge-charger-specs-2023). End: GM Authority reports that Brampton Assembly ended production of the Dodge Charger together with the Challenger on 22 December 2023 (gmauthority-brampton-end-2023).

body.note: Four-door sedan (inferred from the Charger specification sheet). From 2020 the Widebody bodywork was standard on the SRT Hellcat; it is not a separate body style.

configuration.note: 'ENGINE: 6.2-LITER HEMI HELLCAT V-8 SUPERCHARGED'; 'Type and Description 90-degree V-type, liquid-cooled'

drivetrain.note: 'drive only goes to the rear wheels'. Dodge's 2016 sheet gives the Charger layout as 'Longitudinal front engine, rear-wheel drive (RWD) or all-wheel drive (AWD)', with AWD listed only for SE and SXT models.

transmission.note: 'TRANSMISSION: 8HP90 TORQUEFLITE AUTOMATIC EIGHT-SPEED / Availability Standard on Charger SRT Hellcat'. The only transmission; the 2023 sheet: 'Availability Standard on SRT Hellcat, SRT Hellcat Redeye' (dodge-charger-specs-2023).

powerHp.note: Rating for model years 2015-2019, five of the car's nine model years. Quote (Dodge 2016 specifications): "Power (SAE J2723) 707 hp (527 kW) at 6,000 rpm". The 2018 and 2019 sheets repeat "Power (SAE J2723) 707 hp (527 kW) at 6,000 rpm" (dodge-charger-specs-2018, dodge-charger-specs-2019); 2015: 'the all-new 2015 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat' with '707 horsepower' (csmonitor-charger-hellcat-2014). From 2020 to 2023 the rating was 717 hp: Dodge 2023 specifications, "Power 717 hp (535 kW) @ 6,100 rpm" (dodge-charger-specs-2023). The Redeye (797 hp) and Jailbreak are separate variants.

weightLb.note: 2016 model year (the only transmission is the 8-speed automatic). Quote (Dodge 2016 specifications): "SRT Hellcat — 4,570 (2,072.9)". No Dodge sheet for 2015 could be opened, so the reference year is 2016, the earliest year with a Dodge figure. Later Dodge figures: 2017 "SRT Hellcat — 4,535 (2,057)" (dodge-charger-specs-2017), 2018 and 2019 "4,536 (2,057)" (dodge-charger-specs-2018, dodge-charger-specs-2019), 2023 (standard Widebody) "4,594 (2,083) — SRT Hellcat" (dodge-charger-specs-2023). The Christian Science Monitor gave 4,560 lb for the 2015 car (csmonitor-charger-hellcat-2014). See discrepancies.

sources.title: Charger Hellcat from Dodge is the most powerful sedan in the world. Officially.

discrepancies.reason: Model year. Dodge revised the figure from year to year: 4,570 lb (2016), 4,535 lb (2017), 4,536 lb (2018-2019), 4,594 lb (2023, Widebody standard). 4,560 lb is a press report for the 2015 launch car.
discrepancies.resolution: Used Dodge's 4,570 lb because the reference model year is 2016.

discrepancies.reason: Model year. 707 hp for 2015-2019, 717 hp for 2020-2023.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 707 hp, the rating for five of the nine model years and for the 2016 reference year. The change is too small to split the record.
